all_frame_signal_screen.black_frame_definition: mean luma below 25/255 or max below 60/255 at 160x90 area-scaled decode
all_frame_signal_screen.interpretation: Static holds within one count/intro/teaching are intentional. This scan rejects a freeze crossing a planned count update.

producer_based_encode_integrity.scope: All frames of opening/closing fades, six teaching/intro fades, completion-stamp neighborhood, and nine numeric baseline values. Expected pixels use existing production Scene, so this is complementary to the separate independently constructed glyph/math oracle.
producer_based_encode_integrity.criterion: Mean absolute RGB error tolerates H264 YUV420 chroma/quantization changes; thresholds bound full and individual instruction/header areas rather than using byte equality.
